activities.name: racIdentityMatch

config.prompt: Pair each mechanism with what it builds:

pairs.right: children learn selfhood by practising other people's viewpoints
the internalised standpoint of the community — society's voice
identity performed front-stage, edited back-stage, co-produced by audiences
norms enforced by glances, gossip, inclusion and exclusion, long before law arrives

config.why: Two implications carry the page: identity is granted as well as claimed, and control is largely informal — formal control is the hard tip of a vast soft system.

statements.s: Somewhere in your twenties the self finishes assembling, after which it merely persists.
statements.why: Secondary socialisation keeps running; the mirror never closes.

statements.s: Workplaces, media and relationships keep socialising adults.
statements.why: The project never finishes — affiliations joined and shed.
Joined and shed — the project never finishes.

statements.s: Adults still read themselves in others' responses.
statements.why: The looking-glass stays open all life long.

config.prompt: What share of human genetic variation lies within continental populations rather than between them, in Lewontin's classic analysis?
config.why: About 85% within — folk categories map onto no discrete groups; visible traits vary clinally with geography and select independently.

activities.caption: drag between the claimed and the assigned
activities.name: racEthnicCompare

config.prompt: Drag between the claimed and the assigned:

before.label: Ethnicity
before.text: shared culture, language, ancestry and self-identification — claimed, flexible, plural: Welsh-Scottish-Nigerian-British is available.

after.label: Race
after.text: the imposed end of the spectrum — the category society assigns you regardless of your claim, the assignment that keeps arriving unchosen.

config.why: Who gets to define is the whole difference — and minority identities assert both, chosen culture against the unchosen category.

activities.caption: find the faulty line — what construction means
activities.name: racConstructedSpot

config.prompt: One line of this summary is wrong — click it:
lines: Biological race: a folk belief with no taxonomy behind it.
Race's effects: confirmed in the numbers, every day.
Durable because encoded — in deeds, zoning maps, models and estates.
Show a category is constructed and it stops doing any sorting.
The encoding outlasts any individual bigot's attitudes.
config.correction: Constructed categories keep sorting lives while they stand — made, not found; and because they were made, they can be remade.
config.why: Construction is about origin, not reality — which is exactly why the categories have teeth.

activities.anchor: The sorting itself is measurable, not impressionistic
activities.caption: place today's index on the 0–1 scale
activities.name: racDissimilarityPlace

config.prompt: Place today's US Black-white metropolitan dissimilarity index:
config.why: Near 0.5 — down from around 0.7–0.8 at mid-century; 0.6 would mean six in ten would need to move tract for even distribution — substantial segregation with no law requiring it.

activities.anchor: How should diverse societies manage difference?
activities.caption: file each claim under its model
activities.name: racModelsSort

config.prompt: Three ideal models of managing difference — file each claim:

items.label: adopt the host culture wholesale — the old melting-pot expectation
identity loss; 'symbolic ethnicity' is what survives
public recognition and support for difference under shared rights — Canada first, 1971
critics worry about parallel lives and illiberal practices inside communities
participate fully in economy and polity while retaining identity
what most European policy now nominally targets

config.why: Outcomes, not labels: access predicts integration results far better than official ideology does — and superdiversity complicates every model.
